title: $AGIALPHA — infrastructure efficiency opportunity scan
objective: Compare three proposed node infrastructure improvements and identify the strongest bounded experiment. All inputs in this example are synthetic assumptions.

sources.title: Illustrative compute invoice
sources.text: Synthetic example: monthly compute spend is $2000. An operator proposes caching repeated analytical requests.

sources.title: Illustrative operator interview
sources.text: Synthetic example: a batch scheduling change may reduce idle capacity. The estimates have not been independently measured.

opportunities.title: Cache repeated analysis
opportunities.rationale: Assumed savings require a seven-day cache hit-rate experiment.

opportunities.title: Batch low-urgency requests
opportunities.rationale: Assumed savings depend on acceptable latency and measured idle time.

opportunities.title: Expand speculative capacity
opportunities.rationale: Large assumed upside is offset by capital exposure and uncertain demand.
